description: Defines an immutable model class 'NewsArticle' representing news articles, including methods for serialization/deserialization with database maps and API JSON data.

classes.name: NewsArticle
classes.description: Immutable data class representing a news article with fields for headline, image, description, URL, source, publication time, and content.

methods.name: toDbMap
methods.description: Serializes the NewsArticle object into a map suitable for database storage.

methods.name: fromDbMap
methods.description: Creates a NewsArticle instance from a database map.

methods.name: fromNewsApiJson
methods.description: Creates a NewsArticle instance from a JSON object received from News API.
